candidates.alt: Deck sits at the head of a long conference table speaking into a chain of paper cup telephones. At the far end, Bolt consults a torn scrap of note on his clipboard while reaching for a big red lever labeled NO.
candidates.alt_joke: Every layer swears it forwarded the instructions verbatim.
candidates.caption: Somewhere between the supervisor and the fourth subagent, never touch billing became touch billing.
candidates.concept: Authorization quietly erodes as an instruction is delegated down an agent hierarchy.

candidates.alt: Deck poses with a gold trophy on a spotless indoor obstacle course of perfectly spaced cones while Bolt holds the exit door open to a chaotic rainy street; Deck's screen shows a loading spinner.
candidates.alt_joke: The benchmark was indoors for a reason.
candidates.caption: State of the art, provided the state never changes.
candidates.concept: An agent that aces the clean benchmark freezes the moment it meets the messy real world.

candidates.alt: A small robot works at a desk beside a towering stack of tickets while a laptop wearing sunglasses reclines on a lounger, receiving a single glowing ticket labeled HARD from a conveyor belt.
candidates.caption: The frontier model handles the hard 7 percent. Bolt handles the other 93, plus the filing.
candidates.concept: Only 7% of agent turns need a frontier model; the other 93% is Bolt doing the grunt work

candidates.alt: Bolt sits in a literal wooden sandbox beside a small glowing database cylinder, filing index cards, while Deck leans over the edge covered in sticky notes.
candidates.alt_joke: The sticky notes are Deck's schema.
candidates.caption: Every agent gets a database in its sandbox now. Bolt has already normalized his to-do list to third normal form.
